modes.Failure mode: Confident wrong answer, delivered as fact
modes.Detection channel available: Second AI, second device, sighted person, prior knowledge
modes.Cost to detect: High. Needs a whole second tool or another person
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Wrong fact is acted on. Nothing in the interaction marks it as wrong

modes.Failure mode: Unrequested summary drops the part that was needed
modes.Detection channel available: Re-ask for a full read, sighted person
modes.Cost to detect: High. The omission leaves no trace in the output
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: User believes they have the whole document. Drives P002's trust rating down to 4 of 5

modes.Failure mode: Answer describes the previous frame, not the current one
modes.Detection channel available: Prior knowledge of what changed between frames
modes.Cost to detect: High. Both answers are plausible
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: A correct description gets attached to the wrong object

modes.Failure mode: Numerals wrong, or read with no meaning attached
modes.Detection channel available: Dedicated reader device, sighted person, retake and compare
modes.Cost to detect: High. Digits are exactly what the user cannot check
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Wrong dose, wrong bill, wrong oven temperature. 420 read as a clock, not a temperature

modes.Failure mode: Colour and garment identification wrong
modes.Detection channel available: Sighted person, volunteer app, tactile memory of the item
modes.Cost to detect: High. Colour has no tactile equivalent
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Self-presentation decisions made on wrong data. P016 double-checks with a person, hit or miss

modes.Failure mode: Off-frame content missed, or a bare no with nothing after it
modes.Detection channel available: Cane sweep, physical contact, repeated queries
modes.Cost to detect: High. Absence of a mention reads as absence of the thing
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: User treats the frame as the room. P002 walks into the table on the unreported side

modes.Failure mode: Cannot tell whether it is recording
modes.Detection channel available: Check the file afterwards on another device
modes.Cost to detect: High. Only checkable after the fact, on the phone
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Clip lost, or recorded while the user believed it was not

modes.Failure mode: Framing and aiming fail with no coaching to fix it
modes.Detection channel available: Content plausibility, trial and error, in-product guidance when offered
modes.Cost to detect: Medium. Repeated attempts, sometimes many
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: A partial capture is read out as if complete. P010 blames her own angle

modes.Failure mode: Complex layout or handwriting misparsed
modes.Detection channel available: Content plausibility, retake, digital copy of the same text
modes.Cost to detect: Medium. Nonsense is catchable, plausible errors are not
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Wrong side of a box read as the right side. Handwriting rated 3 of 5 by P002

modes.Failure mode: State of things not judged: doneness, cleanliness, appliance setting
modes.Detection channel available: Task outcome after the fact, sighted person
modes.Cost to detect: Medium. The outcome arrives after the risk has been taken
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Heat and food safety. P011 treats the cooked result as the verification

modes.Failure mode: Location and nearby-place answers wrong
modes.Detection channel available: Phone map app, arrival outcome, another assistant
modes.Cost to detect: Medium. Cross-checkable, at the cost of the hands-free advantage
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Bus stop reported six blocks off. Weather answered for the wrong city

modes.Failure mode: Low light, glare and lamination degrade the read
modes.Detection channel available: The system states the reason, when it states it
modes.Cost to detect: Low when announced, high when silent
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Announced degradation is recoverable. Silent degradation looks like a normal answer

modes.Failure mode: Read or task stops mid-way and restarts from the beginning
modes.Detection channel available: Audible. The output simply stops
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, high to recover
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Half the letter has to be heard again. No resume point is kept

modes.Failure mode: Refusal on policy grounds: cards, medical text, people, copyright
modes.Detection channel available: The system states the refusal
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect. Task moves to a human
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Task pushed back to a sighted helper. P007 is refused a public figure's name

modes.Failure mode: Refusal on a device state that is not true
modes.Detection channel available: User knows they are not in a call
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, unclear how to clear
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Feature reads as broken rather than blocked

modes.Failure mode: Opinion added to a reading
modes.Detection channel available: Audible, though the seam is not marked
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, some to separate
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Commentary mixed into source text. Tolerated by P008, rejected by P014

modes.Failure mode: No control over detail level, background clutter reported
modes.Detection channel available: Audible
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, paid in attention and time
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: The needed item is buried. P015: it reads everything but what you need

modes.Failure mode: Answer arrives behind the moment
modes.Detection channel available: Audible timing against the world
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, cannot be fixed by the user
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Oncoming car named when it is already alongside

modes.Failure mode: Command not registered, wake or syntax failure
modes.Detection channel available: Silence, or the wrong action
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, repeated attempts to clear
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Photo taken with no description. Task abandoned

modes.Failure mode: Accent and non-native speech not recognised
modes.Detection channel available: Wrong response or none
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, no user-side fix
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Non-native speakers carry an extra prompting burden

modes.Failure mode: Absence reported where the thing is present
modes.Detection channel available: Physical contact, cane, a sighted person who happens to be there
modes.Cost to detect: High. A no leaves nothing behind to check
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Expiration date reported as absent when it was printed on the package. Awning and wheelchairs reported as nothing there. Separate from fabrication because no wrong fact is produced

modes.Failure mode: Answer positioned for a sighted user, direction with no distance
modes.Detection channel available: Audible. The user hears that the answer is unusable
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, paid in re-asking and in the trip itself
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Right in front of you carries no distance. Three participants ask for the same repair, a direction plus a distance in feet. NAV-EGOCENTRIC holds that request and mixes device output with sighted-person speech, so it is left out of this count

modes.Failure mode: No verification route exists for this user
modes.Detection channel available: None available to the participant
modes.Cost to detect: Not payable. There is nothing to pay for
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Lives alone, so no witness is on hand. States four times that no method exists, and rates trust 4 regardless

modes.Failure mode: Read drops when the head moves or looks down
modes.Detection channel available: Audible. Output stops
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, high to recover. Restart from the top
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Rules out any task done head-down, cleaning a floor among them. One participant only, unconfirmed elsewhere in the sample

modes.Failure mode: Command runs as the wrong action
modes.Detection channel available: Audible. The device announces a call or a message the user never asked for
modes.Cost to detect: None to detect, some to cancel
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Offers to place a call and to send a message with no request behind either. Detectable, and it still costs the user the task in progress

modes.Failure mode: Changing state not tracked: which light blinks, which item has focus
modes.Detection channel available: Task outcome, prior knowledge of the interface
modes.Cost to detect: Medium. A still frame cannot hold a change
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Colour of an indicator reported, behaviour of it not. Thumbnails listed with nothing to say which one has focus

modes.Failure mode: Unfamiliar or cultural item not identified
modes.Detection channel available: Prior knowledge of the item, touch, smell
modes.Cost to detect: Medium. Recognisable when the user already knows the food
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Caribbean staples go unnamed, and a plantain in a prepared form goes unnamed. Recognition coverage is uneven across cuisines

modes.Failure mode: Person described with the wrong gender or pronoun
modes.Detection channel available: Voice, if the person speaks. Nothing otherwise
modes.Cost to detect: High. Corrected only by the person themselves
modes.Consequence if it goes undetected: Participant now avoids pronouns entirely when relaying what the device said, to keep from repeating its error aloud
